all.text: Keep walking. The people are organized by age—youngest people here, in the front, and older people in the back.

no.text:
Everyone you see around you also does not believe in an afterlife.
Scroll to walk

You heretic! Just kidding.
Scroll to walk

To your immediate right are people who are unsure after an afterlife. On the far right are people who believe in an afterlife.

unsure.text:
Everyone you see around you is also unsure if there’s an afterlife.
Scroll to walk

You have plenty of fence-sitters with you here.
Scroll to walk

To your left are people who don’t believe in an afterlife. To your right are people who do believe.

Most other people in the world agree with you.
